Package com.example.eventlottery.data

Interface EventRepository

All Known Implementing Classes:
FirestoreEventRepository
public interface EventRepository
Repository interface for organizer-created events. Supports: - US 02.01.01: create event - Event list screens: load all events / load events for a specific organizer - Organizer/account cleanup: delete owned events
Version:
1.2
Author:
Kenneth Joseph and hasratsinghchauhan
